data.prompt: In the narrow lane behind the silk shop in the county town deep in the night: a narrow lane paved with worn stone slabs between dark blue-grey brick walls, running straight away from us; on the left a long bamboo pole with four plain cloths drying over it and two wooden tubs below, on the right a round brick well under a small thatched roof, and far down at the end of the lane one small warm light glowing on the wall above a dark wooden double door; cold blue moonlight from above, the small warm light far down the lane, the wet stones gleaming: low wide shot at knee height down the lane: on the left in the middle of the lane A-ling, in her plain grey-white cotton dress with long sleeves covering her wrists, her black hair in a high bun with one plain wooden hairpin, a veil of soft, finely woven pale grey gauze over her nose, mouth and chin, tied behind both ears, falling to just below her jaw, standing, framed full figure, her face three-quarter to screen right toward the men, never the lens; cold and calm: eyes narrowed, brows level; on the right, a few steps away, two broad men in plain black cross-collared short jackets, black cloth head wraps and cloth shoes, the moonlight behind them, their faces in deep shadow, standing side by side across the lane, side-on to us, framed full figure, each gripping one plain wooden stick as long as his arm, smooth and round to its ends in his right hand; just behind them Lai San, small and thin, in his checked grey-brown cross-collared short jacket, a coarse grey cloth apron tied at his waist, an old cloth head wrap below his topknot, limping on his left foot, small, half hidden behind their shoulders, his face three-quarter to screen left, never the lens, his lips closed; their hands hold only what is described here; exactly four people
data.motion: with her right hand A-ling draws out of her right sleeve a short plain dagger in a plain dark wooden sheath, as long as her hand, with a dark wooden grip, and holds it low at her side, still in its sheath; the two men and Lai San stand still, their lips closed, and the cold moonlight and the deep night stay unchanged
